name: escritorio-virtual
description: Escritório Virtual 2D top-down com agentes de IA autônomos (Evoluze)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
